summary: Payments - Reader connection not working, after disconnect from one location and reconnect to another location
reported_issue: A physical card reader/terminal stops working after being disconnected from one location and reconnected to a different location. Setup appears successful and the settings screen shows the reader connected, but sending a payment to the terminal fails and 'Test reader' reports connection failed.
expected_after_fix: After moving a reader between locations, the reconnected reader should actually work and successfully process a terminal payment.
steps_i_followed: Reviewed the reported scenario: it requires a physical Stripe/ShopPay card reader terminal, two shop locations, and live disconnect/reconnect of hardware, then an actual card-present payment to the terminal.
actual_now: Cannot be exercised in this automated harness: it depends on physical card-reader hardware, a live third-party payment terminal (Stripe/ShopPay Terminal), and multi-location hardware re-pairing. No screen/API interaction can simulate the reader firmware handshake or a card-present transaction.
notes: Live 3rd-party payment hardware dependency — out of scope for browser/API automation. Requires manual verification with a real terminal moved between two locations.
